manualCorrection.note: The added 0.43 mi / 292 s is post-plan overtime and belongs to no phase, so `phases` and `splits` are UNCHANGED and deliberately still sum to 5.98 mi / 3057 s. `clockAudit` is left as the original ingest recorded it. routePolyline, elevGainFt, avgCadence and kcal were never captured for this run and are not invented here.
manualCorrection.reason: Run truncated at the last structured phase (6th walk back). The watch offered no reachable End run on a plan ending in a .recovery phase, so the run was force-quit and saved through the crash-recovery path, which takes snapshot-era totals. Fixed in main 8196d683.
